record.name: Coda
record.one_liner: An all-in-one collaborative doc platform combining docs, spreadsheets, and apps.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate an API token directly from their account settings.
record.api_note: The API covers documents, pages, tables, rows, columns, formulas, folders, and publishing settings.

evidence.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs
This MCP server is not developed or maintained by Coda; it's a community-built project.
